Rank 19 - Logistics

Local Courier and Parcel Counter Tracker

Parcel counters need booking, status, delivery proof, cash, and customer message tracking.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 12,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 800Recommended monthly charge

BDT 800/month can work because counters process many parcels and status calls cost time.

7.2Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 12,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 800Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 10,800,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Target local courier counters, district parcel services, market delivery operators, and small logistics shops.

Customers ask where parcels are, staff search notebooks, and delivery proof is weak.

Every parcel has a status and proof.

Validation signals

  • Courier pain is visible in Bangladesh local delivery.
  • Status tracking reduces calls.
  • Branch counters can pay per location.
  • Proof of delivery reduces disputes.

MVP modules

  • Parcel booking
  • Sender/receiver
  • Status update
  • Delivery proof
  • Cash due
  • Branch note
  • Daily parcel report

Do not build first

  • Do not build national courier network.
  • Do not add rider GPS first.
  • Do not custody COD money first.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Pilot with 3 counters.
  • Print parcel ID slips.
  • Use WhatsApp status sharing.
  • Add branch transfer later.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • COD complexity.
  • Lost parcel blame.
  • Multi-branch sync.
Mitigations
  • No custody at first.
  • Photo proof.
  • Cloud tier for branches.
